title: Firmament
subtitle: Test your grasp of the Firmament — flat enclosure, dual-layer sky, Black Void Plasma, Dark Matter Field, Ice Walls, Freemason globe lies, and the G.A.A. Sky Event exposure.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: The Firmament is not myth decoration — it is the outer structural membrane that bends light and sound so physical eyes can see, fitted only to a flat horizontal plain. Globe spin, Heliocentrism, black vacuum, and random asteroids are prison software: dual sieves, Black Void Plasma, fake stars on the inner dome, Ice Walls, and 33rd-degree enforcement keep curiosity dead beyond Antarctica. Sit with what you missed, then return to the Firmament deep-dive. When the G.A.A. kills the Projection Dome, Polaris melts into pixelation past your knees and bright white Dark Matter Field light hits — NPCs and science-devout minds meet catatonia. Knowing the Firmament now is the mandatory first step into the Great Spiritual Awakening.

questions.question: True or False: According to the report, “Firmament” refers to the outer structural membrane enclosing the physical plain that bends light and sound, an absolute requirement for granting physical eyes their perception.

options.rationale: True — the report defines “Firmament” this way.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: It is true — the report defines “Firmament” as: The outer structural membrane enclosing the physical plain that bends light and sound, an absolute requirement for granting physical eyes their perception.

questions.hint: Recall how the report's Key Terminology defines “Firmament”.

options.rationale: True cosmology is a flat horizontal plain. The spinning-sphere-in-vacuum model is manufactured illusion.

options.rationale: Globe spin at nearly 1,000 mph is dismantled as false; a globe could never support a Firmament.

options.label: D
options.text: 178 disconnected globes floating in black vacuum with no Ice Wall partitions.
options.rationale: Gateway-10 is 178 interconnected worlds on flat realms enclosed by the Firmament and partitioned by Ice Walls.

questions.hint: Flat horizontal plain — not a spinning sphere.

questions.question: Why can a globe Earth never support a Firmament?

options.rationale: Ice Walls are horizontal partitions of the flat plain, not globe-supporting pillars.

options.rationale: Black Void Plasma blackens the sky illusion; it does not make a globe-compatible Firmament viable.

options.rationale: A sphere cannot sustain the structure. A globe-style enclosure would need impractical giant pillars hundreds of miles high.

questions.hint: Impractical pillars / Dyson Sphere-style hundreds of miles.
